## Records carrying a detail note

**AR-A1 (A1)** — A1 names Alya (Kontraktor Junior, attributed to 'Keputusan Bariah T04'), Encik Rahman (Mentor / Kontraktor Senior) and Hilmi (Narator, Seluruh K5), and records Haziq and Encik Roslan as replaced / no longer used. Section G has no A1 row, so there is no option mark and no reconciliation row. It is an assertion of a prior decision, repeated by the named authority inside a dated artifact.

**AR-C5 (C5)** — CROSSWALK CORRECTION. C5 was previously read as an independent generator-contract rule. It is not. It has no checkbox anywhere in Sections A-F; its only explicit confirmation is the Section G row 'Penerapan formula pada B03 (C5) | B03 sahaja — kandungan unit'. C5's own text says 'Susunan ini khusus untuk B03. Unit lain akan mengikut formula C4...'. It is therefore a B03 CONTENT IMPLEMENTATION RECORD derived from C4, confirmed only through Section G — neither a pure Section-G reconciliation of an A-to-F decision, nor a generator contract in its own right.

**AR-D1 (D1)** — D1 is confirmed by D4(a) 'TERIMA — copy D1 digunakan seadanya untuk B03', which IS an A-to-F option mark. D1 needs no mark of its own because D4(a) accepts it by reference.

**AR-D2 (D2)** — D2 states verbatim 'Label ini TIDAK dipaparkan kepada pelatih.' and is confirmed through D3 rule 1, which IS an A-to-F option mark.

**AR-E2 (E2)** — E2 attaches its own verification clause: 'keperluan ini akan disemak oleh manusia, bukan oleh pemeriksa automatik. Kehadiran tanda soal sahaja tidak dianggap memenuhi syarat ini.' The rule is confirmed; its verification is explicitly withheld from automated checking.

**AR-F2b (F2(b))** — F2(b) confirms the CHANNEL by which keys will be reviewed. It confirms no key. The document's own scope statement excludes 'Soalan kuiz sebenar dan kunci jawapan setiap unit'.

**AR-F5 (F5)** — The 2-panel option is unchecked and 'Tangguh' is unchecked. The calibration finding was recorded alongside the choice: at 3 panels the source-row list had to be shortened; at 2 panels it did not; full provenance was retained at both densities.

**AR-F6 (F6)** — CONDITIONAL. The acceptance is predicated on the amendments being applied to B03 and on the named authority being satisfied with the result. Neither has happened. F6 does NOT make B03 instructionally approved.
